About the Project

Oxford's industry studentships sit within the Autonomous Intelligent Machines and Systems CDT. They support doctoral research linked to AI and intelligent systems, with the scientific project and industry relationship defined by the individual studentship. This PhD opening at University of Oxford centres on Industry DPhil Studentships in Autonomous Intelligent Machines and Systems, Oxford. The work sits within Artificial Intelligence, Robotics. The role is based in Oxford, United Kingdom. According to the listing, funding covers the full cost of participation; financial support is listed as £21,805/year (UKRI minimum stipend 2026/27). Applications close 27 January 2027.

Research Areas

  • Artificial intelligence
  • Robotics
  • Autonomous systems

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryStipend and tuition; exact amount not stated

Eligibility and Requirements

A previous master’s qualification is not required for this studentship. Candidates are assessed against the DPhil’s academic entry requirements as set out in the studentship advertisement.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round27 January 2027
LocationUnited Kingdom

About University of Oxford

Oxford offers doctoral research through its departments and colleges. The DPhil is its doctoral qualification, and funded research projects have their own supervision, academic selection and application requirements.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://aims.robots.ox.ac.uk/study/industry-studentships

Source: aims.robots.ox.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 27 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 27 January 2027. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
